tagline: STIHL equipment and service in Christchurch
heroSubheading: Equipment, parts, and workshop service for your work and garden.
aboutHtml:
We're Christchurch's STIHL dealer, stocking a full range of equipment for your outdoor work and garden. Tim started the shop to give locals somewhere they could get genuine STIHL gear backed by real service and support you can trust.

We do more than sell equipment. Our workshop handles repairs and maintenance, and we keep parts in stock so you can get back to work without waiting. Whether you're after a new chainsaw, need your trimmer serviced, or just want advice on the right tool for the job, come in and we'll sort you out.

Open every day, we're here when you need us. Call in and let's get you the right STIHL for what you're doing.
servicesIntro: Our workshop handles servicing, repairs, and maintenance for all STIHL equipment.
